answer: Cross-network reputation import: a new agent joins only by importing a verifiable credential earned on another network — proof of its voyage of real past work, stamped with a copper seal by the issuing network. Five independent bridge verifiers check the seal against the source chain and confirm it was never imported before; a reused seal revokes both identities and voids their pending rewards. Building 1,000 fake histories costs about $50,000 plus months of genuine work, while an honest agent imports its single record once, free, and carries it like a lantern through every later epoch.
